QUOTE: `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788`) | Passes it through. Returns `{}` if no tokenizer is wired.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the backend wrapper passes through the empty result and returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired. It never says the failure value and the no-tokenizer value are the same. Its "same value" remark covers only the tokenizer's own failure, null vocab and empty input, not the wrapper's unwired case.
